method: Primary signal: Sourcegraph public code search (sourcegraph.com stream API, context:global, non-fork, non-archived repos, TS/JS/SFC files). All files importing from remeda were fetched with multi-line regex queries and parsed locally: named imports (value imports only, aliases resolved, v1 names folded into v2 names), namespace imports (import * as R, then R.name usage via an AND query), plus require/dynamic forms. Excluded: remeda's own repo and any repo whose name contains remeda or es-toolkit, forks, archived repos, node_modules/dist/build/vendor, .d.ts, five benchmark/comparison/vendored repos, and vendored paths. De-duplication: repos sharing >= 5 identical (last-two-path-segments + function set) file signatures were merged into clone clusters (one 36-repo opencode-derived cluster and 3 pairs); identical files inside a cluster, and identical full-path+function-set files across repos (6 files), were counted once. Metrics per function: remedaCount = files using it (deduped sample of 2143 files in 121 repo clusters); remedaShare = count/2143; remedaRepoShare = share of repo clusters using it at least once; remedaBalancedShare = mean over repo clusters of the within-cluster file share, weighted by sqrt(cluster file count). score = mean(remedaShare, remedaRepoShare, remedaBalancedShare); bootstrap (1000 resamples of repo clusters, seed 20261007) gives scoreP05/P95 and tierProbability. Tier = high if score >= 8%, mid if >= 2% and used in >= 4 repo clusters, else low. Lodash fallback: functions with < 5 sampled files or < 4 repo clusters and >= 30,000,000 lodash per-method downloads/month (excluding packages dominated by a known transitive dependent) are at least mid. Adopter tie-break: functions whose score is within 25% below a tier threshold and that are used by an adopter package with >= 1M downloads/month move up one tier (applied to no function). Adopter signal: tarballs of @prisma/dev and ten other npm dependents were scanned for remeda imports (or the esbuild metafile for bundled @prisma/studio-core). Lodash proxy: last-month downloads of lodash.<lowercased name> per-method packages for every lodash function whose docs mapping page names a Remeda function; lodashDownloads is the sum over the lodash functions mapped to the Remeda function (tap has no package). pipeShare = share of deduped remeda-importing files that import pipe or use R.pipe.
